errors.text_span: Етикетите по оста X са разположени на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The chart's x-axis has a label for every year from 2000 to 2012, but the description states they are placed every two years.

errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия, обозначена като „Железопътен транспорт“, също е плътна и започва от стойност 36,8% през 2000 година.
errors.evidence: The starting value for the orange line (Rail transport) in the year 2000 is 44.9%, not 36.8%. The value 36.8% corresponds to the year 2001.

errors.text_span: достига до максимум 7,9% през 2006 и 2007 година
errors.evidence: The statement claims the maximum value for the blue line is 7.9% in 2006 and 2007. This is incorrect. The actual maximum value is 8.8% in 2008. Additionally, the value in 2006 is 6.9%, not 7.9%.

The description fails to mention the markers used for each line series (diamonds for road transport, triangles for rail transport, and squares for water transport), which are a key part of the data encoding.
